correctness.rationale: Summing independent leaves gives alpha/(1+beta)=1/2 and Bernoulli(r) leaves. The transfer matrix for fugacity 1/2 gives stated finite-cycle mean p_n and Fourier eigenvalues, with constant mode s_n strictly least (even-cycle bound and odd-cycle sign checked). Total covariance yields a Fourier 2x2 block [[a,-ra],[-ra,r²a+c r(1-r)]]. Positive rank-one order in a pins the least mode to s_n. Schur-complement Q_t(r) is strictly concave and tangency H(t) crosses once, proving unique maximin r_n<1/2 and strict suboptimality of r=1/2. Independent enumeration n=3..10 reproduced rim Fourier spectra and optimum; infinite proof rests on exact transfer and tangency, not grid search.
